```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 9,
                      fig.height = 5, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(amorem)
source("case-helpers.R")
source("anim.R")
type_lab <- c("1" = "extrasystemic", "2" = "interstate", "3" = "intrastate", "4" = "internationalized intrastate")
type_col <- c("1" = "#C99A3B", "2" = "#C8729A", "3" = "#178E8E", "4" = "#8E7CC3")
short <- function(x) gsub("Government of ", "", x)
```

# Armed-conflict dyads, 1946–2025

`ucdp_dyads` is the dyadic dataset of the Uppsala Conflict Data Program
(UCDP, version 26.1, CC BY 4.0): one row for every year in which a
government (`sender`, side A) and an opponent (`receiver`, side B) fought
with at least 25 battle-related deaths. The opponent is a rebel group, or
another government in an interstate conflict. `intensity_level` is 2 (war,
1,000 or more deaths in the year) or 1 (minor conflict). This case study asks
how strongly a dyad's own past predicts its fighting in a given year, how
fast that memory fades once a conflict stops, and whether a government at war
with one opponent is more likely to fight another.

```{r data}
data(ucdp_dyads)
u <- ucdp_dyads
c(dyad_years = nrow(u), dyads = length(unique(u$dyad_id)),
  governments = length(unique(u$sender)), opponents = length(unique(u$receiver)),
  first = min(u$year), last = max(u$year))
table(type = type_lab[as.character(u$type_of_conflict)], intensity = u$intensity_level)
```

A few sides are coalitions (side A lists several governments, for example the
Arab states in 1948); each is kept as one actor.

## Who fights whom

```{r network, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 7.4, fig.alt = "Network of governments and their opponents for the dyads with the most years of fighting, coloured by type of conflict"}
dy <- aggregate(list(years = rep(1, nrow(u))), u[c("sender", "receiver")], sum)
ty <- tapply(u$type_of_conflict, paste(u$sender, u$receiver, sep = "\r"), function(z) as.numeric(names(which.max(table(z)))))
dy$type <- ty[paste(dy$sender, dy$receiver, sep = "\r")]
dsel <- dy[order(-dy$years), ][1:150, ]
lay <- layout_graph(data.frame(from = dsel$sender, to = dsel$receiver, w = dsel$years), seed = 3)
gov <- lay$id %in% u$sender
yrs <- tapply(c(dsel$years, dsel$years), c(dsel$sender, dsel$receiver), sum)
nodes <- data.frame(id = lay$id, x = lay$x, y = lay$y, size = as.numeric(yrs[lay$id]),
                    col = ifelse(gov, "#4A5560", "#B9C0C5"), label = NA)
glab <- names(sort(yrs[names(yrs) %in% u$sender], decreasing = TRUE))[1:12]
olab <- names(sort(yrs[!names(yrs) %in% u$sender], decreasing = TRUE))[1:4]
nodes$label[match(c(glab, olab), nodes$id)] <- short(c(glab, olab))
par(mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 2.6, 0.5))
draw_network(nodes, data.frame(from = dsel$sender, to = dsel$receiver, w = dsel$years,
                               col = type_col[as.character(dsel$type)]),
             max_lwd = 3.5, node_scale = c(0.5, 3), label_cex = 0.6)
gx <- nodes$x[gov]; gy <- nodes$y[gov]
points(gx, gy, pch = 22, bg = "#4A5560", col = "white", cex = 0.5 + 2.5 * sqrt(nodes$size[gov] / max(nodes$size)), lwd = 0.8)
n_inter <- sum(dsel$type == 2)
title_left("Most conflicts are stars: one government against many opponents",
           sprintf("150 dyads with most years of fighting, 1946-2025; %d of them interstate. Squares: governments; dots: opponents; line colour: type", n_inter))
legend("bottomleft", legend = type_lab, col = type_col, lwd = 3, bty = "n", cex = 0.68, text.col = ink)
```

```{r network-numbers, include = FALSE}
opp_per_gov <- sort(tapply(dy$receiver, dy$sender, function(z) length(unique(z))), decreasing = TRUE)
```

Intrastate conflicts make the network a set of stars: one government against
many rebel groups. `r short(names(opp_per_gov)[1])` has fought
`r opp_per_gov[[1]]` different opponents, `r short(names(opp_per_gov)[2])`
`r opp_per_gov[[2]]` and `r short(names(opp_per_gov)[3])`
`r opp_per_gov[[3]]`. Interstate dyads join governments to each other and
appear as the few lines between stars.

## Spells, gaps and recurrence

```{r raster, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 7.6, fig.alt = "One row per dyad and one column per year, coloured by intensity, for the 40 dyads with the most years of fighting"}
top <- dy[order(-dy$years), ][1:40, ]
key <- paste(top$sender, top$receiver, sep = "\r")
first <- tapply(u$year, paste(u$sender, u$receiver, sep = "\r"), min)[key]
top <- top[order(first, -top$years), ]; key <- paste(top$sender, top$receiver, sep = "\r")
R <- nrow(top); yy <- 1946:2025
lab <- paste0(short(top$sender), " - ", short(top$receiver))
lab <- ifelse(nchar(lab) > 46, paste0(substr(lab, 1, 45), "."), lab)
par(mar = c(2.6, 16, 2.6, 0.8))
plot(NA, xlim = range(yy) + c(-0.5, 0.5), ylim = c(0.5, R + 0.5), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
abline(h = 1:R, col = "#F1F3F4", lwd = 0.8)
uk <- paste(u$sender, u$receiver, sep = "\r"); m <- match(uk, key)
s <- !is.na(m)
rect(u$year[s] - 0.5, R + 1 - m[s] - 0.4, u$year[s] + 0.5, R + 1 - m[s] + 0.4,
     col = ifelse(u$intensity_level[s] == 2, "#0B4F4F", "#7FC1C1"), border = NA)
axis(1, at = seq(1950, 2020, 10), tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.72, col.axis = ink_soft, line = -0.6)
axis(2, at = R:1, labels = lab, las = 1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.55, col.axis = ink, line = -0.5)
title_left("Dyads fight in spells separated by gaps, and move between minor conflict and war",
           "40 government-opponent dyads with most years of fighting, ordered by first year; light: minor conflict; dark: war")
```

```{r anim-data, include = FALSE}
br <- seq(1946, 2026, 2)
win_lab <- paste0(br[-length(br)], "-", br[-1] - 1)
role_col <- c(setNames(rep("#4A5560", length(unique(u$sender))), unique(u$sender)),
              setNames(rep("#B9C0C5", length(unique(u$receiver))), unique(u$receiver)))
role_col[unique(u$sender)] <- "#4A5560"
glab12 <- c(names(sort(table(u$sender), decreasing = TRUE))[1:12],
            names(sort(table(u$receiver[!u$receiver %in% u$sender]), decreasing = TRUE))[1:3])
glab12 <- setdiff(glab12, "Government of DR Congo (Zaire)")   # drawn on top of the IS hub
dy_win <- tapply(paste(u$sender, u$receiver), findInterval(u$year, br), function(z) length(unique(z)))
```

```{r anim, echo = FALSE}
anim_events(u$sender, u$receiver, u$year, br, win_lab, node_col = role_col,
            edge_col = type_col[as.character(u$type_of_conflict)], n_nodes = 120,
            node_label = setNames(short(glab12), glab12),
            title = "Armed conflicts, two years at a time",
            sub = "dark: governments; light: opponents; line colour: extrasystemic (ochre), interstate (pink), intrastate (teal), internationalized (violet)",
            fps = 3, alt = "Animation of the government-opponent dyads that fought in each two-year window, 1946-2025")
```

The number of dyads that fight within a two-year window is `r dy_win[[1]]` in
`r win_lab[1]`, peaks at `r max(dy_win)` in
`r win_lab[as.integer(names(which.max(dy_win)))]`, and is
`r dy_win[[length(dy_win)]]` in `r win_lab[length(win_lab)]`.

Most long dyads fight in spells: years of fighting, a gap, and fighting again
with the same opponent. The next figure counts how often a dyad that has
fought before is active again, by the number of years since it last fought.

```{r hazard-data}
active <- split(u$year, paste(u$sender, u$receiver, sep = "\r"))
haz <- do.call(rbind, lapply(active, function(y) {
  y <- sort(unique(y)); yrs <- (min(y) + 1):2025
  last <- vapply(yrs, function(t) max(y[y < t]), 0)
  data.frame(gap = yrs - last, active = yrs %in% y)
}))
h <- aggregate(list(active = haz$active, n = rep(1, nrow(haz))), list(gap = haz$gap), sum)
h$rate <- h$active / h$n
head(h, 4)
```

```{r hazard, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4.4, fig.alt = "Share of dyads fighting again, by years since they last fought"}
hh <- h[h$gap <= 30, ]
par(mar = c(3.4, 3.8, 2.6, 0.8))
plot(hh$gap, hh$rate, log = "y", type = "n", ylim = c(min(hh$rate[hh$rate > 0]), 1), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
lines(hh$gap, hh$rate, col = alpha(pal[1], 0.5), lwd = 1.2)
points(hh$gap, hh$rate, pch = 21, bg = pal[1], col = "white", cex = 0.6 + 2.2 * sqrt(hh$n / max(hh$n)))
axis(1, at = c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30), tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.72, col.axis = ink_soft, line = -0.6)
axis(2, at = c(0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1), labels = pct(c(0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3, 1), 1), las = 1,
     tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.7, col.axis = ink_soft, line = -0.6)
mtext("years since the dyad last fought", side = 1, line = 2, cex = 0.72, col = ink_soft)
for (g in c(1, 2, 5, 10)) text(g, hh$rate[hh$gap == g], pct(hh$rate[hh$gap == g]), pos = if (g == 10) 1 else 4, cex = 0.62, col = ink, offset = 0.7)
legend("topright", legend = fmt(c(100, 1000, 3000)), pt.cex = 0.6 + 2.2 * sqrt(c(100, 1000, 3000) / max(hh$n)), pch = 21,
       pt.bg = pal[1], col = "white", bty = "n", cex = 0.62, text.col = ink_soft, title = "pair-years at risk", title.col = ink_soft,
       y.intersp = 1.8, x.intersp = 1.6)
title_left("A government-opponent pair that fought last year fights again; after a gap it rarely does",
           "share of pair-years with fighting, by years since the pair last fought (log scale)")
```

```{r hazard-numbers, include = FALSE}
r_at <- function(g) h$rate[h$gap == g]
```

A dyad that fought last year fights again with probability
`r pct(r_at(1))`. After a gap of two years the share is `r pct(r_at(2))`,
after five years `r pct(r_at(5))` and after ten years `r pct(r_at(10))`.

### Escalation and de-escalation

```{r transitions, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4.6, fig.alt = "Diagram of yearly transitions between peace, minor conflict and war for dyads that have fought before"}
st <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(u, paste(u$sender, u$receiver, sep = "\r")), function(d) {
  yrs <- min(d$year):2025
  s <- ifelse(yrs %in% d$year[d$intensity_level == 2], "war", ifelse(yrs %in% d$year, "minor", "none"))
  data.frame(from = head(s, -1), to = tail(s, -1))
}))
P <- prop.table(table(factor(st$from, c("none", "minor", "war")), factor(st$to, c("none", "minor", "war"))), 1)
pos <- list(none = c(0.12, 0.45), minor = c(0.5, 0.45), war = c(0.88, 0.45))
scol <- c(none = "#B9C0C5", minor = "#7FC1C1", war = "#0B4F4F")
par(mar = c(0.5, 0.5, 2.6, 0.5))
plot(NA, xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0.2, 0.72), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", asp = 1)
arrow_curve <- function(a, b, p, bend) {
  bz <- .bezier(pos[[a]][1], pos[[a]][2], pos[[b]][1], pos[[b]][2], bend, 40)
  d <- sqrt((bz$x - pos[[b]][1])^2 + (bz$y - pos[[b]][2])^2); k <- d > 0.075 & sqrt((bz$x - pos[[a]][1])^2 + (bz$y - pos[[a]][2])^2) > 0.075
  bz$x <- bz$x[k]; bz$y <- bz$y[k]; n <- length(bz$x)
  lines(bz$x, bz$y, lwd = 0.8 + 14 * p, col = alpha(scol[[a]], 0.75))
  ang <- atan2(bz$y[n] - bz$y[n - 1], bz$x[n] - bz$x[n - 1]); hl <- 0.025 + 0.02 * p
  polygon(bz$x[n] + hl * c(0, -cos(ang - 0.5), -cos(ang + 0.5)), bz$y[n] + hl * c(0, -sin(ang - 0.5), -sin(ang + 0.5)),
          col = alpha(scol[[a]], 0.9), border = NA)
  m <- ceiling(n / 2); up <- bz$y[m] > pos[[a]][2]
  text(bz$x[m], bz$y[m] + if (up) 0.035 else -0.035, pct(p), cex = 0.62, col = ink)
}
for (a in names(pos)) for (b in names(pos)) if (a != b && P[a, b] > 0.003) {
  far <- abs(match(a, names(pos)) - match(b, names(pos))) == 2
  arrow_curve(a, b, P[a, b], if (far) -0.32 else -0.22)
}
for (a in names(pos)) {
  symbols(pos[[a]][1], pos[[a]][2], circles = 0.07, inches = FALSE, add = TRUE, bg = scol[[a]], fg = "white")
  text(pos[[a]][1], pos[[a]][2], c(none = "no\nfighting", minor = "minor\nconflict", war = "war")[a],
       col = if (a == "none") ink else "white", cex = 0.7, font = 2)
  text(pos[[a]][1], pos[[a]][2] - 0.105, sprintf("stays: %s", pct(P[a, a])), cex = 0.6, col = ink_soft)
}
title_left("From one year to the next", "transition shares between states of a dyad that has fought before; arrow width grows with the share")
```

```{r transition-numbers, include = FALSE}
p_esc <- P["minor", "war"]; p_deesc <- P["war", "minor"]; p_war_stay <- P["war", "war"]
```

A minor conflict becomes a war the next year in `r pct(p_esc)` of cases; a war
stays a war in `r pct(p_war_stay)` and drops to a minor conflict in
`r pct(p_deesc)`.

## Case-control design for yearly events

The events are dyad-years: `(government, opponent, year)`. All events of a
year share the same time, which matters for both the controls and the
statistics.

**Risk set.** The question is which of the dyads that have fought before is
active in a given year. `sample_non_events(mode = "two")` would draw controls
from every government × opponent pair, and most of those pairs never could
fight (a government and a rebel group of another continent); the dyad's own
past would then separate events from controls almost perfectly. The controls
are therefore drawn from the dyads that fought in an earlier year: five per
event, uniformly, excluding the event's own dyad. A dyad's first year (its
onset) has no comparable risk set here and is left out. A control may be a
dyad that also fought in the same year, as another row: this is the Breslow
convention for tied times, which keeps a tied event at risk.

```{r cc}
ev <- u[order(u$year, u$dyad_id), ]
el <- data.frame(sender = ev$sender, receiver = ev$receiver, time = ev$year)
dk <- paste(el$sender, el$receiver, sep = "\r")
first_year <- tapply(el$time, dk, min)
set.seed(1)
cc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(which(el$time > first_year[dk]), function(i) {
  pool <- setdiff(names(first_year)[first_year < el$time[i]], dk[i])
  sr <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(sample(pool, 5), "\r"))
  data.frame(stratum = i, event = c(1L, rep(0L, 5)), sender = c(el$sender[i], sr[, 1]),
             receiver = c(el$receiver[i], sr[, 2]), time = el$time[i])
}))
c(strata = length(unique(cc$stratum)), rows = nrow(cc), onsets_left_out = sum(el$time == first_year[dk]))
```

**Statistics.** `endogenous_features()` updates the history row by row, so
an event would see the other rows of its own year. To use only earlier years,
each year's rows are scored with `prior_log` holding the events of all earlier
years and an empty `history_log`, so no row of the current year enters the
history.

```{r features}
yrs <- sort(unique(cc$time))
cc <- do.call(rbind, lapply(yrs, function(y)
  endogenous_features(cc[cc$time == y, ], history_log = el[0, ],
                      prior_log = if (any(el$time < y)) el[el$time < y, ],
                      stats = c("recency", "sender_outdegree", "receiver_indegree"))))
# the dyad's own past: number of earlier active years, and war last year
dkey <- dk; ckey <- paste(cc$sender, cc$receiver, sep = "\r")
cc$dyad_past <- mapply(function(k, t) sum(dkey == k & el$time < t), ckey, cc$time)
war_key <- paste(dkey, el$time)[ev$intensity_level == 2]
cc$war_last <- as.numeric(paste(ckey, cc$time - 1) %in% war_key)
cc$last_year <- as.numeric(!is.na(cc$recency) & cc$recency == 1)
# the government's other dyads active last year
gov_last <- table(paste(el$sender, el$time))
cc$gov_other <- as.numeric(gov_last[paste(cc$sender, cc$time - 1)]); cc$gov_other[is.na(cc$gov_other)] <- 0
cc$gov_other <- cc$gov_other - cc$last_year
cc$log_dyad_past <- log1p(cc$dyad_past)
cc$log_gov_past <- log1p(cc$sender_outdegree); cc$log_opp_past <- log1p(cc$receiver_indegree)
cc$log_gov_other <- log1p(cc$gov_other)
```

## Linear model

```{r clogit}
covs <- c("last_year", "war_last", "log_dyad_past", "log_gov_other", "log_gov_past", "log_opp_past")
fit <- rem(reformulate(covs, response = "event"), data = cc, method = "clogit")
ct <- summary(fit$fit)$coefficients
round(ct[, c("coef", "exp(coef)", "se(coef)")], 2)
```

```{r forest, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4, fig.alt = "Coefficients of the conditional logit with 95% intervals"}
lab <- c(last_year = "dyad fought last year", war_last = "dyad at war last year",
         log_dyad_past = "log(1 + earlier years of the dyad)", log_gov_other = "log(1 + government's other conflicts last year)",
         log_gov_past = "log(1 + government's earlier dyad-years)", log_opp_past = "log(1 + opponent's earlier dyad-years)")
est <- ct[covs, "coef"]; se <- ct[covs, "se(coef)"]; y <- length(covs):1
par(mar = c(3.4, 18, 2.8, 1))
plot(est, y, xlim = range(c(est - 2 * se, est + 2 * se, 0)), ylim = c(0.5, length(covs) + 0.5), type = "n", axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
abline(v = 0, col = rule, lwd = 1.2)
segments(est - 1.96 * se, y, est + 1.96 * se, y, col = pal[1], lwd = 2.2)
points(est, y, pch = 21, bg = "white", col = pal[1], cex = 1.3, lwd = 1.6)
text(est, y + 0.3, sprintf("x%.2f", exp(est)), cex = 0.6, col = ink_soft)
axis(1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.75, col.axis = ink_soft, line = -0.5)
axis(2, at = y, labels = lab[covs], las = 1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.72, col.axis = ink, line = -0.6)
mtext("effect on the log-rate (95% interval); labels: factor on the rate", side = 1, line = 2, cex = 0.72, col = ink_soft)
title_left("Which of the dyads that fought before fights this year", "conditional logit, five controls per dyad-year from the dyads with a past")
```

```{r clogit-numbers, include = FALSE}
hr <- function(v) fmt(exp(ct[v, "coef"]), 1)
```

Fighting last year multiplies the rate by `r hr("last_year")`, holding the
other terms fixed, and war last year by a further `r hr("war_last")`. Each unit
of `log(1 + earlier years)` of the dyad multiplies it by
`r hr("log_dyad_past")`. The government's other conflicts last year multiply
the rate of fighting a given opponent by `r hr("log_gov_other")` per unit, and
its total earlier dyad-years by `r hr("log_gov_past")`.

## How fast the memory of a conflict fades

The recurrence shares above do not separate the gap from the other terms. In
the `gam` backend (one control per dyad-year) the gap enters as a smooth
`nl()` of the log of the years since the dyad last fought; a gap of one year
is "fought last year", so the smooth replaces that indicator. `tv()` lets the
effect of the government's other conflicts change over the eighty years.

```{r gam}
cc$gap <- log(cc$recency)
cc$year <- cc$time
w <- widen_case_control(cc, covariates = c("gap", "war_last", "log_gov_other", "log_opp_past", "year"))
gfit <- rem(~ war_last + log_opp_past + nl(gap, k = 6) + tv(log_gov_other, k = 6),
            data = w, method = "gam", time = "year")
summary(gfit)$s.table
```

```{r smooth, echo = FALSE, fig.height = 4.2, fig.alt = "Smooth effect of years since the dyad last fought, and the time-varying effect of the government's other conflicts"}
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(3.4, 3.6, 2.6, 1))
d1 <- smooth_data(gfit$fit, 1); d1 <- d1[d1$x <= log(60), ]
lo <- d1$fit - 1.96 * d1$se; hi <- d1$fit + 1.96 * d1$se
plot(d1$x, d1$fit, type = "n", ylim = range(lo, hi), axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "")
abline(h = 0, col = rule, lwd = 1.2)
polygon(c(d1$x, rev(d1$x)), c(lo, rev(hi)), col = alpha(pal[1], 0.18), border = NA)
lines(d1$x, d1$fit, col = pal[1], lwd = 2.2)
axis(1, at = log(c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50)), labels = c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50), tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.72, col.axis = ink_soft, line = -0.5)
axis(2, las = 1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.72, col.axis = ink_soft, line = -0.5)
mtext("years since the dyad last fought (log scale)", side = 1, line = 2, cex = 0.7, col = ink_soft)
mtext("effect on the log-rate", side = 2, line = 2.3, cex = 0.7, col = ink_soft)
title_left("The pull of a past conflict fades with the gap", "smooth effect with 95% band")
d2 <- smooth_data(gfit$fit, 2)
draw_smooth(d2, col = pal[2], xlab = "year", ylab = expression(beta(t)))
title_left("A government's other conflicts, over time", "effect of log(1 + other conflicts of the government last year)")
par(op)
```

```{r smooth-numbers, include = FALSE}
f_at <- function(d, x) approx(d$x, d$fit, xout = x)$y
slope <- coef(lm(fit ~ x, data = d1))[["x"]]
st <- summary(gfit)$s.table
drop <- f_at(d1, log(1)) - f_at(d1, log(10))
b <- c(f_at(d2, 1960), f_at(d2, 1990), f_at(d2, 2020))
```

The fitted smooth is close to a straight line in the log of the gap
(`r fmt(st[1, "edf"], 1)` effective degrees of freedom), so the rate falls as
a power of the gap, about gap^`r fmt(slope, 1)`. On the log-rate scale it
falls by `r fmt(drop, 2)` between a dyad
that fought one year ago and one that last fought ten years ago, a
factor of `r fmt(exp(drop), 0)` on the rate. The effect of the government's
other conflicts is `r fmt(b[1], 2)` around 1960, `r fmt(b[2], 2)` around 1990
and `r fmt(b[3], 2)` around 2020 (log-rate per unit of `log(1 + conflicts)`);
the test of the time-varying term gives p = `r fmt(st[2, "p-value"], 2)`, so
the data do not show a change over time.

## What the design leaves out

- **Onset of new dyads.** First years of dyads are left out; the model
  describes which dyads with a past fight again, not how new conflicts start.
- **Deaths.** The data give only the intensity class; the number of deaths
  is in the UCDP battle-related deaths dataset.
- **Global trends** (the end of the Cold War, the year itself) cancel within
  a stratum, since every row of a stratum has the same year; `tv()` above
  captures how an effect changes, not how the overall number of conflicts
  changes.
